title: Concept: GraphQL schema definition published
description: A schema definition document with type declarations in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The definition lists every type and field including the internal ones, so an attacker can query relationships the interface never exposes.
applicability: Deployments that render a schema definition document with type declarations into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The definition lists every type and field including the internal ones, so an attacker can query relationships the interface never exposes.
